messages.subject: For Michael Dorrell | Infrastructure, digital growth and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Stonepeak Corporate Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Michael Dorrell, Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder.

Stonepeak's investment strategy across digital infrastructure, power and transport increasingly operates at the intersection of governments, permitting, communities and operating partners. That environment closely matches my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder execution across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, infrastructure stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Stonepeak's investment platform. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Stonepeak.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
